description: This file defines the WebhooksRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for webhooks using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application.

classes.name: WebhooksRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing webhook data, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createUserWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook for a specific user with provided data.

methods.name: createEventTypeWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: createOAuthClientWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook for a specific OAuth client platform.

methods.name: updateWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing webhook identified by webhookId.

methods.name: getWebhookById
methods.description: Retrieves a webhook by its unique ID.

methods.name: getWebhookSubscriberUrl
methods.description: Fetches the subscriber URL of a webhook by ID.

methods.name: getUserWebhooksPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated webhooks for a user.

methods.name: getEventTypeWebhooksPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated webhooks for a specific event type.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWebhooksPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves paginated webhooks for an OAuth client.

methods.name: getUserWebhookByUrl
methods.description: Finds a user webhook by user ID and subscriber URL.

methods.name: getOAuthClientWebhookByUrl
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client webhook by client ID and URL.

methods.name: getEventTypeWebhookByUrl
methods.description: Finds an event type webhook by event type ID and URL.

methods.name: deleteAllEventTypeWebhooks
methods.description: Deletes all webhooks associated with a specific event type.

methods.name: deleteAllOAuthClientWebhooks
methods.description: Deletes all webhooks for a specific OAuth client.
